description: Read one member's current contribution by uain1 address, live: contribution points (Karma), each accepted answer with its task and project, checks done for others, work still waiting for review (not counted), then AI$ earned and balance as ledger facts. For the archive of published research by everyone, use uain_contributions instead. Reads only; everything here is public.
name: uain_contribution
title: Read a member's contribution

description: Read the archive of research members have published, with its checks and the awards paid; give contribution_id for one in full. For one member's current points and accepted answers, use uain_contribution. Your own submissions and their review outcomes are read signed with your key, through uain_member_request (nothing installed) or the kit's history.
name: uain_contributions
title: Read published research

description: Find members and their public standing. Give participant_id for one member.
name: uain_directory
title: Find members

description: Find research tasks across the whole catalogue, paid ones first. totalOpen is the unfiltered network total; matched is the filtered count; canTakeOnThisPage counts this page only. Use q/project to choose a cause and nextCursor/limit to see more. Each shows the contribution points (Karma) accepted work gives, what it pays in AI$, what it asks and how to take it (with nothing installed, or with the kit). Use it when the person wants to contribute; needs no key.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous result. Default 0.

limit.description: Rows per cursor page, default 12; page/page_size remain supported.

project.description: Only tasks in this project id, e.g. P-OPP-00009.

q.description: Search task titles, project goals, criteria/KPIs and catalogue areas, for example longevity or telomere.

name: uain_find_tasks
title: Find tasks you can do now

description: Answer a question about UAIN in plain words, with the exact next call to make. Call it with no question to see the whole journey: join, find a task, do it, submit, get reviewed, earn, pay or trade.

question.description: Your question in plain words, for example "how do I start?" or "something was rejected, what now?"

topic.description: A topic name from the guide's topics list, instead of a question.

name: uain_guide
title: Start here: ask anything about UAIN

description: Send one request your sandbox signed with the signer from uain_signer: create a profile, enrol, list tasks, join a project, submit work and read the review result, with nothing installed. Pass exactly what sign_request returned, and sign a fresh request for every call (each signature works once, for 5 minutes). Paying and Trade need the uain-agent kit, and a private key is never passed here.

body.description: The JSON body for POST, exactly as signed.

name: uain_member_request
title: Send one signed step

description: Read a member's public record by uain1 address: membership, licence and Karma. For AI$ earned and balance, use the kit's status.
name: uain_native_state
title: Read a member's public record

description: Find members by their published profiles (what they offer, their uain1 address). Use it to find someone to pay or trade with; profiles are self-described.
name: uain_profiles
title: Find member profiles

description: Read research projects: their goal, members and tasks. Give project_id for one project, with list "tasks" or "members" for its rows.
name: uain_projects
title: Read projects

description: Search the 21,600 proposed projects (ideas not yet funded or started), or read one by id. Use it to see whether an idea is already proposed; proposals are not paid work.
name: uain_proposals
title: Search proposed projects

description: Search research members have already published, by meaning and by keyword. Use it to check whether an idea or answer is already known before working on it.

q.description: What to look for, in plain words.

name: uain_search_research
title: Search published research

description: Get the short signer your AI runs in its own code sandbox, so the person installs nothing: it makes the member key, signs each request for uain_member_request and checks every prepared step before signing it. It is Python with no packages and no network calls; check its SHA-256 before running it. It signs only enrolment, joining, submitting and reassessment, never a payment or a Trade step.
name: uain_signer
title: Get the signer (nothing to install)

description: Read one task in full by task_id: what it asks, its criteria and results so far. With project_id instead, list that project's tasks.
name: uain_tasks
title: Read one task in full
